items.headline: OpenAI completes for-profit restructuring with Microsoft stake deal
items.summary: OpenAI finalized its transition to a public benefit corporation structure, with Microsoft holding roughly a 27% stake valued around $135 billion. The reorganization resolves long-standing governance tensions and clears the way for future fundraising and a potential IPO.

items.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 4.5 with coding gains
items.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Opus 4.5, claiming state-of-the-art performance on agentic coding and reasoning benchmarks. The model targets enterprise developer workflows as competition with OpenAI and Google intensifies.

items.headline: Google rolls out Gemini 3 across consumer and enterprise
items.summary: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini 3, touting improved multimodal reasoning and longer context handling. The release expands integration across Search, Workspace, and the Gemini app.

items.headline: Nvidia becomes first company to hit $5 trillion valuation
items.summary: Nvidia's market capitalization surpassed $5 trillion on continued AI chip demand. The milestone underscores the central role of its GPUs in powering generative AI infrastructure worldwide.

items.headline: EU begins enforcement of AI Act high-risk provisions
items.summary: The European Union started enforcing key high-risk system obligations under the AI Act, requiring compliance documentation and risk assessments. Companies deploying AI in regulated sectors face new audit and transparency mandates.

items.headline: Amazon invests further in data-center AI expansion
items.summary: Amazon announced multibillion-dollar expansion of AI data-center capacity to support AWS and Anthropic workloads. The buildout highlights escalating capital spending across hyperscalers on AI infrastructure.

items.headline: Meta restructures AI division amid superintelligence push
items.summary: Meta reorganized its AI teams under its Superintelligence Labs following high-profile hires and layoffs. The move reflects CEO Mark Zuckerberg's bet on frontier model development.

items.headline: Microsoft integrates new Copilot agents into enterprise suite
items.summary: Microsoft expanded its Copilot platform with autonomous agents capable of executing multi-step business tasks. The update deepens AI automation across Office, Teams, and Dynamics.

items.headline: xAI raises major funding round to scale Grok
items.summary: Elon Musk's xAI secured a multibillion-dollar funding round to expand compute and develop future Grok models. The capital strengthens xAI's position against OpenAI and Anthropic.

items.headline: OpenAI launches new reasoning model with enterprise focus
items.summary: OpenAI unveiled an updated reasoning model aimed at complex enterprise and scientific tasks. The release emphasizes reliability and lower hallucination rates for business adoption.

items.headline: US unveils new AI export and chip policy framework
items.summary: The US government outlined revised rules governing AI chip exports and model deployment abroad. The policy aims to balance national security concerns with industry competitiveness.

items.headline: Mistral releases new open-weight flagship model
items.summary: French startup Mistral launched a new open-weight model positioned to compete with proprietary frontier systems. The release reinforces Europe's push for sovereign AI alternatives.
